title: Clique in an encoded graph
statement: Let $v$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $G$ assign a Boolean value to each two-element subset of the vertex set $\\{0,1,\ldots,v-1\}$. The graph encoded by $G$ contains a clique of size $k$ if there is a set $S$ of $k$ vertices such that every two distinct vertices in $S$ are adjacent.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define adjacency, so the exact relation between the Boolean values assigned by $G$ and adjacency cannot be stated.
